content.user_title: Generate Semantic HTML From PDF Pages
content.value_statement: PDF page recreation often loses structure, hierarchy, and exact text boundaries. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to produce semantic HTML from image, text, and layout inputs.
actual_capabilities: Uses a PNG page image as a visual layout reference.
Uses extracted JSON text data to preserve page content accurately.
Uses an ASCII preview to infer structure and element relationships.
Specifies semantic HTML5 elements, heading hierarchy, lists, tables, and figures.
Requires exact page boundary preservation to reduce invented text.
Defines validation checks for text coverage and HTML structure.
limitations: It is a prompting workflow, not a complete converter by itself.
Generated HTML still needs deterministic validation before publishing.
Visual accuracy depends on the quality of the source PNG and extracted text.
Complex tables or figures may require manual review after generation.

use_cases.title: Convert textbook pages
use_cases.description: Create semantic HTML pages from textbook page images and extracted text while preserving page boundaries.

use_cases.title: Prepare accessible document markup
use_cases.description: Generate HTML with headings, lists, figures, and tables that is easier to validate for accessibility.

use_cases.title: Build a validation pipeline
use_cases.description: Use AI for first-pass HTML generation, then pass results to deterministic structure and text checks.

prompt_templates.title: Generate one page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single PDF page artifact set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ai-html-generate skill for page 6. Use the PNG image, rich extraction JSON, and ASCII preview. Return semantic HTML5 only.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve exact text
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt when text fidelity matters most.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate HTML for this page and preserve every word from the extraction JSON. Do not add bridging text, captions, or missing sentence endings.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a chapter opening page
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for pages with chapter titles and navigation sections.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate semantic HTML for this chapter opening page. Include the chapter header, navigation list, section divider, and correct heading hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Regenerate after validation failure
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for correcting missing or invented text.
prompt_templates.prompt: Regenerate the page HTML because text coverage failed. Compare the HTML against the extraction JSON and remove any words not present in the source.

output_examples.input: A chapter opening page with a PNG rendering, extracted JSON spans, and an ASCII outline.
output_examples.output: A complete HTML5 page with a chapter header, navigation section, semantic headings, paragraphs, and linked stylesheet.

output_examples.input: A continuation page that starts mid-sentence and includes bullet items.
output_examples.output: A page body that starts exactly at the extracted text boundary and represents bullets as semantic list items.

output_examples.input: A page with a figure, caption, and surrounding paragraphs.
output_examples.output: A semantic page using figure and caption structure while preserving all extracted paragraph text.

best_practices: Provide all three inputs for each page: image, extracted JSON, and ASCII preview.
Run text coverage validation immediately after each page is generated.
Regenerate pages that contain invented text or miss large sections.
anti_patterns: Do not consolidate pages before each page passes text verification.
Do not ask the model to complete broken sentences across page boundaries.
Do not rely on visual appearance alone when extracted text data is available.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates semantic HTML5 for a single PDF page using image, text, and structure inputs.

faq.question: Does it convert a whole PDF automatically?
faq.answer: No. It describes a per-page generation workflow that should be combined with validation and consolidation steps.

faq.question: Why are three inputs required?
faq.answer: The image provides layout, JSON provides exact text, and ASCII preview provides structural relationships.

faq.question: Can it add missing words for readability?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly requires every word to come from the extracted source data.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should happen after generation?
faq.answer: Run deterministic validation for HTML structure and text coverage before using the generated page.
